Thank you for your submission. We found two required fixes before staff can start detailed review.

## Summary
Your proposal can stay in the small-home pre-review path, but staff need clearer height and code evidence before the Stage 1 gate can clear.

## What to fix before resubmitting
- Lower the building height from 12.0 m to 11.5 m or less on the elevation drawings.
- Add a Part 9 code summary. Part 9 is the building-code path for small residential buildings. Include life safety, exiting, and assembly notes.

## Optional improvements
- Add the height datum on the elevations so staff can verify the revised value quickly.

## Next step
Upload a revised Stage 1 resubmission package in the permit portal with the updated elevations and Part 9 code summary included.
